Container.Name: ArchipelagoManager
Container.Overview:
Host, generate and share Archipelago multiworld randomizers from a web UI.
- Run several multiworlds at once, one server per game (pregenerated or generated here) - Upload a pregenerated zip: patch files are extracted and linked to the players they belong to - Every user keeps their own YAML configs; admins generate games from them - Custom games (.apworld) are stored, and you are prompted to add them when one is missing - Admin and player views, live server console, progress per slot
Open the web UI after starting the container to create the administrator account. Every hosted game needs one port of the game port range, so publish the whole range.

Config.Name: Game ports
Config.Description: One port per hosted game. If you change this range, change 'Game port range' below to the same values.

Config.Name: Data (appdata)
Config.Description: Database, player configs, games, patch files and Archipelago's host.yaml. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: What players type to reach your server: a domain name or IP address. Leave empty to use the address you open the web UI with. Can be changed later in the web UI.

Config.Name: Game port range
Config.Description: Ports the manager hands out to games. Must match the published 'Game ports'.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Optional. Creates the first administrator on start instead of showing the setup page. Only used while there are no users.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Optional password for the administrator above (at least 8 characters).

Config.Name: Trusted proxy IPs
Config.Description: Only when using a reverse proxy: its address, so the manager trusts X-Forwarded-Proto and marks cookies as secure over HTTPS.

Config.Name: Max upload (MB)
Config.Description: Largest file accepted for multiworld zips and .apworld files.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the manager runs as. 99 is Unraid's 'nobody'.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the manager runs as. 100 is Unraid's 'users'.

Config.Name: Update check
Config.Description: Ask GitHub for new releases of Archipelago and of custom games added from GitHub, and tell admins about them. Set to false to stop all requests to GitHub the manager makes on its own.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: For example Europe/Berlin. Affects timestamps in server logs.
